# CASE-2026-041 — Retention and Erasure Decision  
| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Case ID | CASE-2026-041 |
| Document ID | CASE-041-RETENTION |
| Version | 1.0 |
| Decision Date | 2026-07-07 |
| Owner | Data Protection Officer |
| Status | Active legal and regulatory hold |
| Supersedes | None |
| Superseded By | None |
| Related Documents | [[case_2026_041_overview]], [[case_2026_041_incident_timeline]], [[case_2026_041_complaint_record]], [[policy_privacy]], [[policy_retention]], [[policy_aml]] |  
The customer’s access request is acknowledged; erasure is not approved while the incident, complaint, regulatory assessment, and AML-related hold remain open.  
| Data | Action |
|---|---|
| Marketing preferences | Suppress immediately if requested |
| Unneeded duplicate copies | Restrict and review for deletion |
| Incident, complaint and notification records | Retain and restrict |
| AML/KYC and transaction evidence | Retain under regulatory obligation |
| Subject access material | Provide electronically after identity check |  
Review the hold on 2026-10-07 and after all matters close. Explain the hold and review point without saying erasure is permanently denied.

raw_entities.name: CASE-2026-041 — Retention and Erasure Decision
raw_entities.description: A data protection and compliance case concerning a customer's access and erasure request in the context of an open incident, complaint, and regulatory assessment. The case involves retention obligations under AML/KYC rules and active legal and regulatory holds pending review on 2026-10-07.
context: Case ID | CASE-2026-041
Status | Active legal and regulatory hold
The customer's access request is acknowledged; erasure is not approved while the incident, complaint, regulatory assessment, and AML-related hold remain open.
Review the hold on 2026-10-07 and after all matters close.

raw_entities.name: Retention and Erasure Decision — 2026-07-07
raw_entities.description: A Data Protection Officer ruling issued on 2026-07-07 that denies erasure of customer data while incident, complaint, regulatory assessment, and AML-related holds remain open. The decision establishes a hold review date of 2026-10-07 and specifies differential treatment of data categories: marketing preferences to be suppressed if requested, duplicate copies to be restricted and reviewed, incident/complaint records to be retained and restricted, and AML/KYC/transaction evidence to be retained under regulatory obligation.
context: Decision Date | 2026-07-07
Owner | Data Protection Officer
Status | Active legal and regulatory hold
Review the hold on 2026-10-07 and after all matters close.

raw_entities.description: An immediate suppression action on marketing preferences data if the customer requests it, as part of the retention decision framework.
context: Marketing preferences | Suppress immediately if requested

raw_entities.name: Unneeded Duplicate Copies Restriction and Review
raw_entities.description: A restriction and review action on unneeded duplicate copies of data for potential deletion, pending completion of the hold review.
context: Unneeded duplicate copies | Restrict and review for deletion

raw_entities.name: Incident, Complaint and Notification Records Retention
raw_entities.description: A retention and restriction action on incident, complaint, and notification records to preserve evidence and support ongoing regulatory and legal obligations.
context: Incident, complaint and notification records | Retain and restrict

raw_entities.description: A mandatory retention action on AML/KYC screening and transaction evidence data under regulatory obligation, to be maintained throughout the hold period.
context: AML/KYC and transaction evidence | Retain under regulatory obligation

raw_entities.description: A customer's formal request for access to personal data and erasure of records, acknowledged but not approved pending closure of the incident, complaint, regulatory assessment, and AML-related hold.
